name: jaipur-vo-1
text:
Eighteen seventy-six. A British prince is on his way to Jaipur... [short pause] and the Maharaja orders the whole old city painted pink.
But Jaipur was already special. Founded in seventeen twenty-seven by Sawai Jai Singh the Second... laid out on a grid... one of India's earliest planned cities.
The pink came about a hundred and fifty years later. Sawai Ram Singh the Second chose it... a colour of welcome... for Albert Edward, the Prince of Wales.
Then the twist. In eighteen seventy-seven, a law reportedly made pink compulsory in the old city. [pause] Your house. Your wall. Not your colour.
And the colour outlived the Raj. In twenty seventeen, Jaipur's smart city plan set aside about fourteen point six crore rupees to restore bazaar facades in the original shade. And in twenty nineteen, UNESCO listed the walled city as a World Heritage Site.
So... would you let your city choose your paint? Because in Jaipur... it all started in eighteen seventy-six.
